text: you can not just dunk in a graph.path or we will eat shit. they have to bake as sdf
resolution: Correction folded into req_1925: I had started toward rendering the category glyphs as live Graph.Path; the user stopped me ('you can not just dunk in a graph.path or we will eat shit. they have to bake as sdf'). Honored it — the glyphs bake into the SDF atlas (cat.<id>) and render via SdfIcon as one quad each, with the live PathIcon only as a stale-atlas fallback. Verified the baked path renders via shot.
